# Job Chapter 36 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 429v–430r

---

**36:1** And-added [vayosef] Elihu and-said: **36:2** "Wait-for-me [katter-li] a-little [ze'eir] and-I-will-show-you [va-achavveka], for yet [od] for-God [le-Eloah] [there are] words [millin]. **36:3** I-will-carry [essa] my-knowledge [dei] from-afar [le-merachoq], and-to-my-Maker [le-fo'ali] I-will-ascribe [etten] righteousness [tsedeq].

**36:4** For truly [omnam] my-words [millai] [are] not falsehood [lo-sheqer]; one-perfect [temim] in-knowledge [de'ot] [is] with-you. **36:5** Behold, God [El] [is] mighty [kabbir] and-does-not despise [ve-lo yim'as]; mighty [kabbir] in-strength of-heart [koach lev]. **36:6** He-does-not keep-alive [lo yechayeh] the-wicked [rasha], and-justice [u-mishpat] to-the-afflicted [aniyyim] he-gives [yitten].

**36:7** He-does-not withdraw [lo yigra] from-the-righteous [mi-tsaddiq] his-eyes [einav]; and-with kings [malakhim] on-the-throne [la-kisse] he-seats-them [vayoshivem] forever [la-netsach], and-they-are-exalted [vayigba'u]. **36:8** And-if bound [asurim] in-fetters [ba-ziqim], caught [yillakedu] in-cords of-affliction [be-chavlei oni]: **36:9** Then-he-declares [vayagged] to-them their-deeds [po'olam] and-their-transgressions [pesha'eihem], that they-act-proudly [yitgabbaru]. **36:10** And-he-opens [vayigel] their-ear [oznam] to-correction [la-musar], and-says [vayomer] that-they-return [yeshuvun] from-iniquity [me-aven].

**36:11** If they-hear [yishme'u] and-serve [ya'avodu], they-complete [yekhallu] their-days [yemeihem] in-good [ba-tov] and-their-years [u-shneihem] in-pleasantness [ba-ne'imim]. **36:12** And-if they-do-not hear [lo yishma'u], by-the-sword [be-shelach] they-pass-over [ya'avoru], and-they-expire [yigve'u] without knowledge [be-veli-da'at].

**36:13** And-the-godless of-heart [chanfei-lev] set [yasimu] anger [af]; they-do-not cry-for-help [lo yeshavve'u] when he-binds-them [ki asaram]. **36:14** Their-soul [nafsham] dies [tamut] in-youth [ba-no'ar], and-their-life [ve-chayatam] among-the-cult-prostitutes [ba-qedeshim].

**36:15** He-delivers [yechallets] the-afflicted [ani] in-his-affliction [be-onyo], and-opens [ve-yigel] in-oppression [ba-lachats] their-ear [oznam]. **36:16** And-also [ve-af] he-enticed-you [hesitikha] from-the-mouth of-distress [mi-pi tsar] — a-broad-place [rachav] [where there is] no constraint [lo mutsaq] in-its-place [tachteha]; and-the-resting [nachat] of-your-table [shulchanekha] was-full of-fatness [male dashen].

**36:17** But the-judgment of-the-wicked [din rasha] you-have-filled [maleta]; judgment [din] and-justice [mishpat] take-hold [yitmokhun]. **36:18** For [let not] wrath [chemah] entice-you [yesitekha] with-a-clap [be-sefeq]; and-let-not the-greatness of-the-ransom [rov kofer] turn-you-aside [yatteka].

**36:19** Will-he-value [haya'arokh] your-cry [shu'akha] — not in-distress [lo va-tsar] — and-all the-strengths [ma'amatstsai] of-power [koach]? **36:20** Do-not pant [tish'af] for-the-night [ha-lailah], for-the-going-up [la-alot] of-peoples [ammim] in-their-place [tachtam]. **36:21** Take-heed [hishamer], do-not turn [al-tefen] to iniquity [aven]; for this you-have-chosen [bacharta] rather-than affliction [me-oni].

**36:22** Behold, God [El] is-exalted [yasgiv] in-his-power [be-khocho]; who [is] a-teacher [moreh] like-him [kamohu]? **36:23** Who has-appointed [paqad] over-him his-way [darkho]? And-who has-said [amar], 'You-have-done [pa'alta] injustice [avlah]'?

**36:24** Remember that you-magnify [tasgi] his-work [fo'olo], which men [anashim] have-sung [shoreru]. **36:25** All mankind [kol-adam] have-gazed [chazu] on-it; a-mortal [enosh] looks [yabbit] from-afar [me-rachoq].

**36:26** Behold, God [El] [is] great [saggi] and-we-know-not [ve-lo neda]; the-number of-his-years [shanav] — and-there-is-no searching [ve-lo cheqer]. **36:27** For he-draws-up [yigara] drops of-water [nitefi-mayim]; they-distill [yazoqu] rain [matar] for-his-mist [le-edo]. **36:28** Which the-clouds [shechakim] drip [yizzelu]; they-drop [yir'afu] upon mankind [adam] abundantly [rav].

**36:29** Indeed, can-anyone-understand [yavin] the-spreadings of-cloud [mifreshei av], the-crashings of-his-pavilion [teshu'ot sukkato]? **36:30** Behold, he-spreads [paras] his-light [oro] upon-it [alav], and-the-roots of-the-sea [shorshe ha-yam] he-covers [kissah].

**36:31** For by-these he-judges [yadin] peoples [ammim]; he-gives [yitten] food [okhel] in-abundance [le-makhbir]. **36:32** Upon palms [al-kappayim] he-covers [kissah] light [or], and-commands-it [vayetsav aleha] against the-assailant [al-mafgi'a]. **36:33** His-thunder [ra'amo] declares [yaggid] concerning-him [alav], the-cattle [miqneh] also concerning-what-rises [al oleh].

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.5 — "mighty and does not despise":** Hebrew *kabbir ve-lo yim'as* — this is Elihu's key theological claim. God is mighty (*kabbir*) but not contemptuous of humanity. Power and compassion coexist in God. This distinguishes Elihu's theology from the friends' retributive framework.

**v.14 — "among the cult-prostitutes":** Hebrew *ba-qedeshim* — male cult functionaries associated with Canaanite worship. The image is of those whose lives end in degradation because they refused correction. This is one of the harshest images in Job.

**v.26-33 — The storm theophany begins:** Elihu's speech transitions from moral argument to nature poetry. The description of clouds, rain, thunder, and lightning anticipates God's own speech from the whirlwind (ch.38). Elihu may literally be gesturing toward a gathering storm.

*— EMET*
